text:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up for BlueHarbor (dedicated/private). Root cause summary: VPC peering flapped during maintenance -> on-prem NAT failover dropped BGP sessions -> isolation bug surfaced when asymmetric routing occurred. Need owners + timelines for remediation and a short drill plan. Prefer owners by EOD Friday.

sam: I can take peering healthcheck + automated fallback policy. Will pair with devon for testing. ETA next Wed.

devon: SG. I want to simulate heavy connection churn on staging to validate KV cache and route reconvergence. Can you provide test endpoints?

maria: Test endpoints: blueharbor-staging-peers.redwood.internal (use port 11777). Note: capture pcap during the drill for post-run analysis — customer reported asymmetric routing.

jessica: :thumbsup: I'll own the egress ACL work and route validation. Propose adding a BGP neighbor check in CI and an ingress/egress ACL review.

oliver: I'll own running the on-prem NAT failover drill with the customer's SRE. Proposed date Mon 2024-06-10 09:00 PT. Also plan to backport the isolation bug fix into the next minor release.

sam: @jessica can you paste the BGP check snippet? we should reuse infra libs.

jessica: here's a quick check to add to runbooks/CI:

```
# check-bgp-neighbor.sh
ip netns exec mgmt vtysh -c 'show ip bgp neighbors' | grep -E 'Neighbor|Established'
```

devon: We should also add a monitoring alert: "peer flaps > 3/min" that triggers auto-rollback of recent peering config pushes and notifies oncall.

maria: Agreed. Consolidated action items: 
- sam + devon: implement peering healthcheck + staging tests (owner:sam, pair:devon) / due: 2024-06-05
- jessica: egress ACL + BGP check + CI gate (owner:jessica) / due: 2024-06-07
- oliver: run on-prem NAT failover drill w/ customer (owner:oliver) / due: 2024-06-10
- infra-bot: create alert for peer flaps and annotate runbook (owner:infra-bot) / due: 2024-06-04

Please confirm or reassign. I'll add these to the remediation tracker and bring them up in tomorrow's weekly remediation call.

sam: Confirming. I'll open PR and link it here: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/1234

infra-bot: Reminder: scheduled alert created: /alerts/peer-flap-threshold (threshold=3/min).

oliver: Noted. I'll message BlueHarbor SRE and lock Mon 6/10 09:00 PT.

maria: Thanks all. Tagging product for visibility. We'll label this as "isolation pattern B" in the recurring incidents tracker and watch for repeats across Dedicated/Private tenants.

maria: (follow-up) If anyone changes an ownership assignment, drop an update here so I can keep the timeline accurate.
